scope: Ten bounded engineering/art stages toward the full desktop target; separate from the 13-round/78-packet game acceptance ledger. Six specialist workers; not sixty independent assignments.
target: Original YUGA hero/map/screens with commercial hero-shooter quality; not yet achieved.

rounds.title: Freeze reuse contracts and current defects
acceptance: Existing Rama rig/source, courtyard, shaders and locked open-source tools mapped.
Six exclusive ownership scopes and measurable gates.
rounds.review: Reviewed exact baseline bindings, exclusive scopes and rejection gates. This accepts the contract only.

rounds.title: Audit mesh, rest spaces and source compatibility
acceptance: UV seam-aware mesh health and rig alignment measured.
Source hashes and untouched canonical inputs.
rounds.review: Raw glTF and Blender-welded metrics are distinct. Raw exact-position incidence finds no open boundary edges, so UV seams are not called holes. Rig leak measured in actual poses.

rounds.title: Implement source-preserving reuse adapters
acceptance: WebP-aware static intake/optimization with exact semantics or explicit refusal.
Adverse input tests and original-byte preservation.
rounds.review: 15 tests, two actual raw-pair audits and 12 independent adverse cases passed. Compatibility tool accepted; no runtime promotion or performance claim.

rounds.title: Author a conservative hero cleanup candidate
acceptance: Tightly bounded defect mask and displacement.
Matched actual original/candidate views; reject if worse.
rounds.review: Executed and reviewed, rejected for promotion. Exact source preservation passed; actual rear hair defect remains.

rounds.title: Bind and sample a reused hero rig
acceptance: Existing skeleton/action reuse, finite normalized influences.
Actual deformation samples and explicit unresolved contact/shape limits.
rounds.review: Both R1 and R2 rejected. R2 still deforms REST geometry and stretches action edges; filtered family zeros do not prove anatomical correctness. No new rig export promoted.

rounds.title: Implement one wind-court pilot
acceptance: Existing8mfootprint/roof/anchor/routes preserved.
Near/mid budgets and truthful detailed collision.
rounds.review: Single geometry pilot accepted after 65 strict actual capture checks / 16 images, 41 author checks, 818 independent rays and 14 canonical integration counterexamples. Full-game quality credit stays zero.

rounds.title: Build reusable temporal effects
acceptance: Original flame/cast systems reused with real expiry/pause/culling.
Actual native sequence and temporal counterexamples.
rounds.review: 27 lifecycle and 12 independent adverse cases pass. Corrected 72 actual frames plus 3 controls retained; 97/98 automated render checks. Strict conservative AABB gate remains false. Indexed geometry and visible study reviewed separately; no runtime promotion.

rounds.title: Integrate isolated art/runtime previews
acceptance: Accepted candidates only; failed candidates remain isolated.
Existing native/browser source and asset rights preserved.
rounds.review: One accepted court integrated with old body removed and eight native array slots/groups preserved. 29 world, 27 route, 36 stress and 14 independent integration cases pass. Hero candidates stay isolated.

rounds.title: Run independent adversarial and visual review
acceptance: Actual originals inspected, asset/physics/animation failures retained.
Relevant tests plus independent correction confirmation.
rounds.review: Independent original-image and counterexample review completed. Rejected hero results and the VFX strict failure retained. Optional PBR direction accepted separately.

rounds.title: Publish source, dashboard and next gates
acceptance: Exact-source CI and public byte verification.
No unsupported game-quality, hardware or whole-game completion claims.
rounds.review: Source C db1e3291 passed all 38 foundation steps; 39 public HTTP checks, 33 exact static matches and 10 local Chromium checks pass. Publication of this bounded checkpoint is complete. Rejected hero candidates and the strict VFX framing gate remain open.

additional_study.title: Existing CC0 sandstone on the single court
additional_study.scope: Distinct optional native-PBR art study after the no-new-texture geometry pilot; canonical material stays unchanged.
additional_study.review: Accepted isolated material direction after all six actual views; canonical material unchanged. Motion, wider views, LOD and physical-GPU profiling remain open.

continuation.scope: Conditional execution queue with six owners per stage; not ten completed game rounds or sixty executed assignments.
